Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Barnstead Floral Wool Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Charcoal and Beige
Materials: wool
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported A subtle vintage pattern of floral motifs makes this rug ideal for transitional furniture settings. Wool provides a soft hand that creates a welcoming atmosphere to any room. Wool fiber is durable for a busy household. 5' x 8' Hand-tufted in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
